text:
Ananya Patel: Quick sync — can we confirm the onboarding checklist for Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant connector? goal: marketplace listing + joint blog by end of month.
Mike Chen: Yep. I have a draft checklist. Main open items: security review, sample dataset for demo, and connector cert tests.
Jen Park: Security review flagged credential handling for SSO in private deployments. Need to document KMS flow.
Tomas Gomez: For Databricks we need a notebook demo and a short how-to for Delta sharing. I can own the notebook.
Rebecca Li: I'll take ownership of the Snowflake marketplace listing metadata (logos, descriptions, pricing tiers). ETA Fri.
Ananya Patel: Awesome. Can we outline cert test cases here so eng can start? minimal: bulk upload (100k vectors), similarity search latency SLO, cold-start KV cache test.
Mike Chen: Test cases I'm thinking:
- ingest: CSV -> vectorize -> upsert 100k into Qdrant
- query: 1k concurrent similarity queries, p95 < 200ms (on Dedicated config)
- resilience: simulate instance restart with live traffic, fallback to hosted model variant
- security: role-based access + audit log ingestion to Snowflake
Jen Park: Add quantized model variant validation for latency/cost comparison. Also include prompt prefix caching effect on throughput.
Tomas Gomez: For Databricks, notebook will include code snippets. rough:
```python
# sample upsert
from qdrant_client import QdrantClient
q = QdrantClient(url="https://qdrant.example")
q.upsert(collection_name="redwood-demo", points=[...])
```
Mike Chen: Nice. Also add the CLI commands for our connector install: `rbx connector install --provider snowflake --connector redwood-vector`
Ananya Patel: Marketing/PR note: coordinate announcement with Snow listing date. Rebecca, can you check Snow marketplace submission SLA?
Rebecca Li: Snowflake submission window is usually 7–10 business days for certification. If we submit weds, we should be clear for a launch target 2 weeks out.
Jen Park: Ops question: will the cert tests run against Dedicated or Private? we should mirror customer's environment.
Mike Chen: We should run CI on both Dedicated (our infra) and a Private sandbox (customer VPC) for at least the security tests. I'll add infra tickets.
Tomas Gomez: Who's owning the end-to-end demo script for the joint webinar? I can wireframes the flow but need someone to record.
Ananya Patel: Tomas drafts; Mike or Jen can record a short 6-minute demo. Rebecca to sync with marketing for the webinar page.
release-bot: deploy: connector-integration-tests started on runner-03 — job 4821
Mike Chen: CI kicked off. sharing logs: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4821 (internal)
Jen Park: Noted one flake in the ingestion test — hitting rate limit on vectorizer service. I'll add retry/backoff.
Ananya Patel: Good catch. Add to checklist: backpressure + retry strategy documented.
Rebecca Li: I'll block calendar for a content review on Thursday 10am PT. invite sent.
Tomas Gomez: Also checklist item: sample data license for sharing in demos. legal ok?
Ananya Patel: Legal already signed a standard permissive dev dataset. I'll attach in the docs.
Mike Chen: TL;DR action items: Mike -> CI + infra tickets; Jen -> security + retries; Tomas -> notebook + demo script; Rebecca -> marketplace metadata + comms; Ananya -> overall PM + attach dataset.
Jen Park: I'll create the PR for security docs by EOD.
Rebecca Li: I'll prepare marketplace assets and coordinate announcement timeline after cert pass.
Ananya Patel: Thanks team. next sync Thursday after Rebecca's review. If anything blocks, ping me or drop updates here. :rocket:
